name: Shiraishi Kurakichi
source:
﻿A detective working with the K City police station. He is in charge of investigating a case that took place a month ago.

He may have a soft-spoken manner, but in reality, he has a sharp look in his eyes. 

He enjoys playing Go.

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_shiraishi.html]official website[/url]]
